title: Your own tuning in one choice
description: Saved targets for every string instead of setting them by hand again.

blocks.text: For a familiar arrangement the same set of notes has to be chosen all over again.

quote.text: Was fantastic when custom tunings worked. Can no longer create, save, edit or delete custom tunings (and C# is not available for the third string)

blocks.text: Let the tuning be named, the targets saved and the sets switched between. When one is chosen, show clearly what has changed from the previous one.
The name of a set is no substitute for the list of targets: before tuning, the guitarist should see the values that were chosen.
